customManagers.description: Track the Simple English plugin pinned in claude-review.yml, which supplies the `@claude review` output style. github-actions pins a `uses:` SHA but never reads a `ref:` under `with:`, so this checkout is invisible to Renovate without this manager. Captures digest + tag to match the `<sha> # <tag>` convention the SHA-pinned actions already use.

packageRules.description: ⚠️ Hold every Simple English plugin bump for review. This is the one pin whose code RUNS INSIDE the review step, which holds CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, so read the hook sources at the new SHA before the bump merges. The workflow also verifies the style id still resolves against the new checkout, so a bump that moves the plugin layout fails loudly instead of degrading to the default style.
